data.exact_reserve_text: The reserves established in 2020 have proved to be adequate and we have been able to make releases during 2021, especially on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which are now reinsured under a Loss Portfolio Transfer arrangement.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer to Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company
prior_year_events.impact_description: An LPT reinsured the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, providing stability to the Syndicate on any future loss movements on the prior years and resulting in a reinsurance recovery included within net technical provisions of GBP 28.0m.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 81.617m. During 2021 the syndicate recorded favourable prior-year development, with a gross release of approximately GBP 9.539m (11.7% of opening gross claims), driven primarily by favourable claims development on the 2018 and 2019 years of account and supported by a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) in December 2021 which reinsured the 2018/2019 reserves and produced a GBP 28.0m reinsurance recovery. COVID-19 provisions established in 2020 were deemed adequate and allowed releases in 2021.
raw_causal_phrases: The reserves established in 2020 have proved to be adequate and we have been able to make releases during 2021, especially on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which are now reinsured under a Loss Portfolio Transfer arrangement.
An LPT has been put into place in December 2021 reinsuring the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account to Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company.
The reinsurance recovery included within the Net Technical Provisions as part of the LPT was GBP 28.0m.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was not stated as a single gross 'movement in prior years' line. The gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note to technical provisions). The report explicitly references releases on 2018 and 2019 and an LPT providing a GBP 28.0m reinsurance recovery (this GBP 28.0m is reinsurer's share / recovery and is not a gross reserve movement). No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years were disclosed. Confidence: prior-year movement is a calculation from the printed gross triangle (hence 0.8).
